title: CPF Module Schema: Public IP Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-publicip'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

allocation_method.description: (Required) Defines the allocation method for this IP address. Possible values are Static or Dynamic.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

ddos_protection_mode.description: (Optional) The DDoS protection mode of the public IP. Possible values are Disabled, Enabled, and VirtualNetworkInherited. Defaults to VirtualNetworkInherited.

ddos_protection_plan_id.description: (Optional) The ID of DDoS protection plan associated with the public IP.

domain_name_label.description: (Optional) Label for the Domain Name. Will be used to make up the FQDN. If a domain name label is specified, an A DNS record is created for the public IP in the Microsoft Azure DNS system.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

idle_timeout_in_minutes.description: (Optional) Specifies the timeout for the TCP idle connection. The value can be set between 4 and 30 minutes.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

ip_tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of IP tags to assign to the public IP.

ip_version.description: (Optional) The IP Version to use, IPv6 or IPv4.

public_ip_prefix_id.description: (Optional) The ID of DDoS protection plan associated with the public IP.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

reverse_fqdn.description: (Optional) A fully qualified domain name that resolves to this public IP address. If the reverseFqdn is specified, then a PTR DNS record is created pointing from the IP address in the in-addr.arpa domain to the reverse FQDN.

sku.description: (Optional) The SKU of the Public IP. Accepted values are Basic and Standard. Defaults to Basic.

sku_tier.description: (Optional) The SKU Tier that should be used for the Public IP. Possible values are Regional and Global. Defaults to Regional.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

zones.description: (Optional) The availability zone to allocate the Public IP in. Possible values are 1, 2, 3. Defaults to null.

fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name of the A DNS record associated with the public IP. domain_name_label must be specified to get the fqdn. This is the concatenation of the domain_name_label and the regionalized DNS zone.

ip_address.description: The IP address value that was allocated.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Publicip' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
